<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://127.0.0.1:80/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext;
]>
<root>
  <item>Test external DTD subset loading</item>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <fallback-test>
    <xi:include href="nonexistent_file.xml" parse="xml">
      <xi:fallback>
        <default-content>Fallback mechanism activated successfully.</default-content>
      </xi:fallback>
    </xi:include>
  </fallback-test>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns2">
  <sub:element sub:attr="value" id="unique-1">
    <nested xmlns="http://example.org/ns3">
      Deeply nested scoping test.
    </nested>
  </sub:element>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>
<root>
  <processing-instruction target="xml-stylesheet" data="type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"" />
  <data>UTF-16 encoding parser validation path.</data>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author, price)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT price (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY writer "Jane Doe">
]>
<catalog>
  <book>
    <title>XML Parsing Advanced</title>
    <author>&writer;</author>
    <price currency="USD">29.99</price>
  </book>
</catalog>
```
